people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus, answering, spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”
translations.bsb: So Jesus asked the experts in the law and the Pharisees, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath or not?”
translations.kjv: And Jesus answering spake unto the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day?
translations.asv: And Jesus answering spake unto the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath, or not?
